workflow_instructions: Supply a configuration JSON as task.input; its kind is higgs-published-likelihood and its engine is pyhf, combine or hs3.
All configurations require output with a safe filename and format json or json-compact. Study identity, record population, point population, formulas and output representation are supplied inputs.

For pyhf supply likelihood as a path/sha256 pin, measurement, signal_modifier, sample_map, parameterization, points, fit_tolerance and max_seconds. The integer max_seconds ceiling is admitted before approval and checked before each profile evaluation; a scan that reaches it is retained as failed. Every sample carrying signal_modifier must be mapped; additional signal normfactors require a separately declared source interpretation.

Parameterization declares framework kappa or stxs; parameters with name, bounds, initial, unit and label; a formula Program with attributed constants, definitions and outputs; and production/decay/output rate rows. A bundle field instead delegates conversion to the parameterization owner interface.

For combine supply native_configuration as a path/sha256 pin and physics_model with id, combine_release, pois and exact ordered options. No production model is currently admitted without the pinned release module inventory.

For hs3 supply native_configuration as a path/sha256 pin, parameterization, formula_bindings with function/production/decay and points. Repaired HS3 dispatch must preserve source constraints, globals and formula dependencies.

Plan, approve and run through the ordinary scientific lifecycle after registration composition. Read-only recipes and acquisition configurations grant no execution authority. Native dispatch repeats the existing supervised-stage authority check.
Interpret Delta(-2 ln L) against the continuous bounded best fit as a local fit diagnostic. Retain failed fits; no coverage, globality or physics acceptance follows from finite output.

handoffs.registration_owner: Compose this fragment into shared mode/signature/manifest/curation/consult registries; add the science._adapter dispatcher and scope handling seams, method family and effect/cost classification. No direct CLI launch path.
handoffs.native_owner: Provide inputs_with_physics_model(task, base, *, physics_model) and run_with_physics_model(task, base, out, *, physics_model). Bind the admitted registry row and pinned release/image; reuse commands, probes, source custody and supervised execution. Saved ROOT workspace input requires its own admitted source loader; the current recipe covers datacards only.
handoffs.parameterization_owner: Provide published_likelihood_program(bundle) returning the declared framework/parameters/program/rates contract. No inferred default rates or width law.
handoffs.hs3_owner: Provide inputs_with_formula_functions(task, base, *, reparameterization) and run_with_formula_functions(task, base, out, *, reparameterization), preserving full graph semantics and profiling declared points. The request carries model, parameterization, formula_functions, points and physics_validated=false.
handoffs.acquisition_owner: Consume acquire_published_configuration resource detection with supplied record identifiers; acquisition_configuration constructs requests only. Reuse existing launch admission for every fetch; do not add an unaudited fetch path.
handoffs.instruction_owner: Embed workflow_instructions in the inference step and reference docs at composition; regenerate the instruction bundle. Reconcile DIRECTORY.md with directory_rows and log the new declarative admission data. No environment or pristine scientific card changed.
